reasonCodes.CUSTOMER_REFUSED: Customer explicitly refused the parcel at the door.
reasonCodes.CUSTOMER_UNREACHABLE: Courier could not reach the customer after repeated attempts.
reasonCodes.ADDRESS_INCORRECT: The supplied address was incomplete or wrong.
reasonCodes.COURIER_OUTAGE: Delivery failed during a documented courier network outage.
reasonCodes.CHANGE_OF_MIND: Delivered goods were returned inside the returns window.
reasonCodes.DAMAGED_IN_TRANSIT: Delivered goods were returned because the parcel was damaged.
